results.title: Massive sample network, only generic 'quality checks' named -- no temperature monitoring
results.closest_fact_claim: The company is accredited by NABL, CAP, and ISO9001:2008, operates a National Reference Laboratory at Rohini and a Kolkata Reference Laboratory, and describes its quality process only generically as '50+ Quality Checks' -- no specific temperature-monitoring technology is named.

results.title: Barcode tracking confirms identity, not temperature integrity
results.closest_fact_claim: Dr Lal PathLabs operates a hub-and-spoke model -- a reference lab, satellite labs, collection centers, a logistics team, and a home collection team -- with samples barcoded with a unique ID so the company can track every step until the report is uploaded.
